from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Represents a single judgment document with extracted classification features."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as it appears in the text")
    case_nature: str = Field(description="The general legal nature of the case (e.g., Civil, Criminal, Administrative, National Compensation)")
    specific_cause: str = Field(description="The specific cause of action or dispute type (e.g., Execution, Tort, Labor Dispute, Product Liability)")
    administrative_subject: str | None = Field(description="The administrative body involved, if any (e.g., Human Resources Bureau, Justice Bureau, Natural Resources Bureau)")
    criminal_charge: str | None = Field(description="The criminal charge if the case involves criminal conviction (e.g., Intentional Injury, Murder, Fraud)")
    administrative_act: str | None = Field(description="The specific administrative act challenged or performed (e.g., Administrative Registration, Work Injury Recognition, Penalty)")
    evidence_quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document supporting the extraction")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
